notes.title: PIGFACE Early Access Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
hello!

at long last, early access is just around the corner! it’s been a lot of work but i think you guys are really gonna like it. 

also, i just gotta say, having so many conversations at PAX where people showed their love for the game and their love of games gave me the fuel i needed to finish up the content for this EA release. 

i can’t express enough how much it means to me that people are eager and willing to chat with devs and share their thoughts and life experiences, it’s amazing. 

i hope that once this is out you guys will enjoy it a lot and share your experiences so that i can apply that feedback and make the game better and more polished as time goes on. at the end of the day, i’m making a game for you guys. 

see you in a week!



-tito

notes.title: DEMO - Version 0.13
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!



We have a fix for the crashing issue for real this time! Apologies for the delay, it was a weird one to figure out but tito got it!


Patch Notes
Quality of Life

Added number values next to sliders in Options screen

Modified auto-reload for better consistency

Modified cancel reload for better consistency

Bug Fixes

Fixed game crashing after the gamma select screen - For Real This Time

Fixed push notification UI anchor points for resolution scaling

Removed bugged laser sight from s357 and tec9

Fixed ability to duplicate drug items by mantling or interacting during their “use” animation

Fixed the flickering “unfinished” tape in the player apartment

Fixed the ability to scroll through weapons in the pause menu

Fixed armour (now it actually works!)

Fixed canvas scaling for ultrawide users on the start demo screen

Fixed the “loud” statistic not displaying properly in the kit screen when toggling the suppressor on and off

Additions/Adjustments

Adjusted layering of some player HUD elements

Disabled cellphone when interacting with items in the apartment 

Lowered the shelf at the beginning of the combat test to make speedrunning more interesting

Restricted the vertical look limit of the player to -70 and +70 degrees from -90 and +90 degrees

Adjusted the position of the table in the farmhouse to combat weird enemy behaviour 



~ DreadXP and titolovesyou

notes.title: DEMO - Version 0.12
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!



Thank you to everyone who's been playing the demo, telling their friends, and sharing your feedback with us in the forums. Please keep all the feedback coming! We appreciate you taking the time.


Patch Notes
Quality of Life

Shooting an empty gun will now reload

Bug Fixes

Fixed game crashing after the gamma select screen

Fixed player having multiple arms when interacting with items in the apartment

Fixed grenade launcher losing ammo when picking up morphine

Additions/Adjustments

Improved lighting and light placement in Farmhouse 

Adjusted enemy detection sensitivity in Farmhouse

Added a death plane beneath the apartment

Adjusted the position of the window into the blocked off room in the farmhouse

Added additional clipping to some sharp edges in the farmhouse level



~ DreadXP

notes.title: PIGFACE Demo Release
notes.notes:
Finally, after a whole heap of work, the PIGFACE demo is ready! Are you excited? I sure am…


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610995/5ae5eeca4dade42ef5a35ab6412784f4f229134c.gif"]

I’ve tried to polish the hell out of this thing, but honestly I just can’t wait to see clips of people finding all sorts of weird bugs and messing around with the goofy ragdolls. It’ll be for my enjoyment, but it’ll also show me the busted stuff that needs fixing and the cool shit that needs spit-shining.



Most importantly though, I just can’t want to see everyone having fun. 



I’m pretty confident that this demo will give you guys a very good idea of what my vision is for the full thing. The fact that the gameplay loop is basically finalized means that this demo will give you a good idea of how it will actually feel to play the full game. 


It’s not just a combat showcase anymore, it’s the real thing this time.  



Anyways what are you doing reading this? Install the damn thing and play it. Or if you’ve already done that, play it again. And then tell all your friends, I’m sure they are absolutely dying to wishlist this game...

~ Tito
